title: Back-To-Back PlayStation State Of Plays Are Coming This Week
description: Sony has announced that there will be not one, but two, PlayStation State of Play events this week. The back-to-back broadcasts will feature "updates from studios around the world," Sony said in its announcement. The first event, kicking off at 6 AM PT / 9 AM ET on September 3, will feature updates from Sony's own development teams and third-party partners. The event will conclude with an "extended look" at Final Fantasy VII: Revelation. State of Play x2 Right after the first event will be a second State of Play, a State of Play Japan, hosted by Yuki Kaji. This event will provide "deep dives into upcoming games from game studios in Japan and Asia, including new gameplay, announcements, and more." There will be English subtitles available. Sony did not provide any details on how long these State of Play broadcasts will be, but keep checking back with GameSpot for all the news and more.

title: Resident Evil Could Have Its Biggest Opening Weekend Ever With Its New Movie
description: Weapons director Zach Cregger's Resident Evil movie hits theaters on September 17, and analysts predict it will set a record for the franchise. While the majority of the live-action movies turned a decent profit off of a relatively small budget, Cregger's take on the IP is currently projected to have the best opening weekend by a comfortable margin. That's according to the official publication of the National Association of Theater Owners, Box Office Pro. The survival-horror movie is predicted to bring in between $40 and $50 million in its North American opening weekend, which would be almost double Resident Evil: Afterlife's $26.6 million weekend from way back in 2010. The new Resident Evil movie also has a brisk running time of around 95 minutes, so that should allow theater owners to screen the film several times a day to maximize ticket sales. If Resident Evil does hit that $40 million or more mark, it'll be on par with the opening weekend of his last release, Weapons. The 2025 film made $43.5 million at its debut and went on to earn an impressive $270 million at the global box office. If the predictions are on the money, Cregger's Resident Evil will perform a lot better than 2021's Resident Evil: Welcome to Raccoon City, which was a box office bomb that made only $42 million during its theatrical run. But can Resident Evil maintain its momentum past the opening weekend? It's not unusual for movies to lose gas quickly after the first week, but Cregger's films generally tend to have long legs. 2016's Resident Evil: The Final Chapter is currently the best-performing Resident Evil movie with a global box office haul of $312.2 million. title: Minecraft Mobs Arrive As Cookie Treats At Crumbl For Limited Time
description: Chicken cookies! Crumbl has revealed a Minecraft collaboration that introduces six different desserts based on the sandbox game to the menu starting today. Yes, they're all square shaped, and no, there isn't a chicken jockey. Available tomorrow, August 31, through September 5, the four-sided treats include a cookie butter cookie with a chicken topper, a Creeper Key lime sandwich, and a lemon poppyseed cookie topped with a boxy bee. Those three treats are joined by an Enderman cookies-and-cream sandwich, which has purple marshmallow mousse in the middle. Who knew those weirdos could have such a tasty-sounding filling? Meanwhile, the pig-themed dessert is a cherry blossom cookie, with maraschino cherries and cherry cream cheese frosting as two of the key ingredients. Last but not least, there's a grass block cake that features a cinnamon vanilla base, brown cream cheese frosting, and lawn-textured frosting. These special Minecraft treats will be available at Crumbl from August 31 through September 5. The partnership doesn't stop there, either. Crumbl notes that there will be Minecraft mystery spoons, with a special exclusive one for the first 200 people who pick up a six-pack of the crossover cookie treats. Minecraft is not a new kid on the block when it comes to crossovers. Bluey came to the hugely popular game earlier this year, and there have been Minecraft Crocs available in the past. This new collaboration with Crumbl follows Krispy Kreme offering up special Pokemon doughnuts. Looking ahead, Minecraft Dungeons II is set to launch September 29 on PC, PS5, Switch 2, and Xbox Series X|S. 45 Best Minecraft Mods To Build With In 2026 View Images
